propositions: Pure intercepts like verify-commit-ticket dispatch before ensure_initialized and do not self-manage store mount, causing 'ticket store not found' in fresh linked worktrees.
Store mount logic is replicated across multiple dispatch arms and entirely skipped by pure intercepts, making it structurally possible for commands to skip mounting.
A single centralized CLI choke point must run mount (ensure_initialized with init_only=True) before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch, covering all store-touching commands.
Commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must not be force-mounted by the central gate and must continue working without a store.
Per-arm ensure_initialized calls may remain as idempotent re-mounts; the central gate guarantees no command skips mount while REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override continues to short-circuit the gate.
